# key across multiple packages
key T
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct {
	A int
	B string
}

var _ = T{1, "a"}
-- p/p.go --
package p

import "m"

var _ = m.T{1, "b"}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@
 	B string
 }

-var _ = T{1, "a"}
+var _ = T{A: 1, B: "a"}
diff old/p/p.go new/p/p.go
--- old/p/p.go
+++ new/p/p.go
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@

 import "m"

-var _ = m.T{1, "b"}
+var _ = m.T{A: 1, B: "b"}
